content: Anan icsamboen chiec onquiaid icsa ënta quiaid
Utsibo, Nuquin Papan chiaid chuibanquid dadpen iquenquioctiad. Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiamenu, quequin ambi chiaidpenquiocnoc chuibanquid abi yacno chosho isun Nuquin Papan comapenen cuidendac.
Chuibanquidtedishun chua-chuatsëquien chuibantsec. Nuquin Papan chiaid cuembo chuibanquid yec icsaisa yanec adquid. Bëdamboec tabadaid uesquin tantiaquin ismequidquio adquid nendac.
Cabayo anëshquin dëchëdëdcash uidën uash tsadquin nidmec. Aden uidën uaquin bidiacmec.
Adembidi uncaten cano dapa tsibidiacoaic. Cunquequidën comapenen bëcunetiadquiocnobi adembidi icbon nidmec.

Cabayo canobidi nua icnuc abi bidiacmete aniactsëc iquec. Adecbidi icbo nua icnuc aton ana aniactsëc iquec. Aniactsëcquidi oncamequin icbon ambi naid dadpen comapenen chuibanec. Adembidi oncamequin onquiaid icsa chuibanec. Nëdënquiaid dëtsisidash badedquio nidacbimboec onquiaid icsa badedquio nidoaic.
Ana onquiaid icsa chuibanacpaden nabanec adecbidi icsabudquiec icbo. Adquid mayan icsan yua iquec adequi icsate bunec.
Nidaidën capuquid podochoquidbidi matsesën yuampicpaden abi yuaid iquec. Yua quenenash cuenenquiocquid.
Ad yenquio ana iquec. Quenenenquio yec ana onquebudec. Onquiaid icsa adecbidi ënëdtiapimbo iquec. Ana onquiaid icsa tantiabanec adecbidi icsabudquiec tabadendac.
Nuquin Icbo bëdambo iquec, queshumbic ana icbon, Nuquin Icbon uaid matses icsambo iquec, quequin chuibanoaic.
Ana shëcuën utsi bëdamboen chuishumbic utsi icsamboen chuioaic. Aden nuqui chienquio ictiad.
¿Acte batapenquiocquid choaidënuësh batambocquidta chopadic? Padenquio.

Adecbidi ¿cuëte bacuë batambocquidën ëshë bëchi chopecta dëyuctic? Padenquio. Adecbidi, ¿Isitodo dataniadaidën bacuë batambo yecta dëyucpadic? Padenquio. Aidi adesa yacpadquiec Esus tantiaquidën ana shëcuën utsi bëdamboen chuishun utsi icsamboen chiesa ictiad.
¿Tsutsi Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiabenquidquio icpec? quiaid
¿Tsutsi Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiabenquidquio icpec? Adquid yec comapenen Esus tantiaquid nebi, quenquiocquimbi bëdamboec tabadquin ismequid utsi-utsien ma icmebampanuna.
Utsin tantiamenushe queshun ëmbia chiacpadomboen ma napanu quesa icta. Nuquin Papan chiacpadomboen nabanquin ismequid icta.
Adembidi, utsin dëniacnushe queshun namenun chuinuequid Nuquin Papan tantiacpadomboen pausunacmaid nec. Adquid mayan icsan tantiacpadomboen pausunaid nec.

Aden aidën icsamboen tantiacpadomboen abëd icquidon adomboembidi tantiec. Aden tantiec, Utsi dëniacnu, quiash utsi-utsiec dëniacnuequido dadpen yanec. Adquid dadpen icnuc chuiquid dapa tantiate bunesa icpec. Cuesnante bunquiec. Ad icnuc icsateuidi bunquid yampec.

Nuquin Papan tantiacpadomboen pausunaid ad yenquio iquec. Ambi tantiacpadomboen pausunaid yec utsibëd bëdamboec tabadquid iquendac. Adembidi utsi tantiaquin nashunquidquio icoaindac. Adembidi ëbëdtan nabanec cho cac nabanendac. Adembidi, Icsambocquid nec, quenquiocquin bëdamboen nabanquin ismendac. Adembidi, Esus tantiaquid nebi, abi quiacpadomboen bëdamboen naic. Adecbidi utsibo chiec muaisa nendac.
Ambia tantiaquid utsibëd bëdamboec tabadquin ismiac adecbidi utsibëd bëdamboec tabadquid dadpen yanendac.
